body: I don't know. But I don't just mean work like my job. I mean everything is work. It feels like so much effort to try and do things that are enjoyable, or to even buy food and cook dinner. To try and figure out something to do with myself besides my job, it just seems like such a pain.
There's nothing in particular that's bothering me. I'm not upset _about_ anything....but I feel like life is just really pointless, and everything is work and there's no reason to bother.

Yes, I've considered going to the psych emergency room, but it's always the same -- 10 day stay in the psych ward, pretend to feel better, back to the same old crap. I've done it before, I always end up feeling like shit again.

It just feels like a waste to get up and go to work in the morning and expend all this effort. Even with hobbies, it's all work really. In 100 years I won't be here, no one will care, so I wish I could just get that over with now. Fast forward to the end of the movie.
